verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: A DC route is sketched with red arrows from the PV array (page 15) down a building corner (pages 15-16) to the equipment alcove (page 16 bottom, page 17, page 21). A separate earthing route is sketched with orange/green lines from an LA marker on the rooftop parapet (pages 18-19) down the exterior wall (page 20) to the same equipment alcove. However: (1) the coiled green cable on page 19 is left disconnected/coiled per the caption 'left the cables' pending future connection — an explained but currently open end; (2) no distinct DCDB or ACDB enclosure is separately photographed/labeled — only a combined 'Inverter and accessories' panel board and a separate main meter panel (page 17 bottom) with no photographed cable run visibly connecting the two; (3) most of the DC/earthing runs are marked with schematic arrows across separate photos rather than shown as a single continuous, clipped/conduited run, and no conduit is visible along most of the exposed sections.
verdicts.rationale: The overall routing concept (PV → alcove; rooftop LA → alcove) is plausible but not demonstrated as one continuous, clearly conduited/clipped run in the photos, and the link between the inverter alcove and the main meter panel is not visually documented, so this requires manual review.
